purpose: Provides a user-friendly, high-level HTTP client library for Python applications.

components.name: API Interface
components.responsibility: Exposes convenience functions (e.g., get, post, request) for executing HTTP operations.

components.name: Session Manager
components.responsibility: Manages persistent settings, cookie storage, authentication, and redirect handling across multiple HTTP requests.

components.name: Data Models
components.responsibility: Defines core Request, PreparedRequest, and Response data structures for handling HTTP payload data.

components.name: Transport Adapters
components.responsibility: Interfaces with urllib3 connection pools to send prepared HTTP requests over network sockets.

components.name: Authentication
components.responsibility: Implements authentication handlers such as HTTP Basic and Digest authentication.

components.name: Cookie Jar
components.responsibility: Provides dictionary-style cookie management and integration with Python standard library CookieJar objects.

edges.what: Passes request parameters to perform HTTP operations within a session context
Instantiates and prepares PreparedRequest objects and processes returned Response objects
Sends PreparedRequest instances through registered HTTP adapters
Constructs Response objects from underlying urllib3 HTTP responses
Modifies PreparedRequest headers to attach authentication credentials
Extracts cookies from responses and injects cookie headers into PreparedRequest objects
